rights: Generated for VECTOR//NOVA with built-in imagegen. The Apex reference was also generated for this project; no third-party reference artwork supplied.
usage: Full-bleed panoramic cup button background artwork, ready for future menu integration. Background scenery only: no trophy, icon, label or UI composited into these images. Green, gold, red and purple suggest increasing cup challenge without changing individual track difficulty.

reference.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full-bleed panoramic BACKGROUND ART for an Apex Cup selection button in an original futuristic racing game. This image will fill the entire rectangular button. A separate trophy icon and readable label will be overlaid by the game's UI later.
Primary request: convey the highest difficulty and an intimidating final challenge through an atmospheric environment alone. Create a dramatic alien obsidian mountain range: immense sharp, fractured black-rock spires, a deep angular chasm, restrained glowing crimson fissures cutting through the rock, and a turbulent dark red storm sky. A few distant thin lightning forks illuminate the tallest peaks. The environment feels severe, monumental and difficult to conquer.
Style: premium cinematic sci-fi game environment art, convincing rock and atmosphere, strong large-scale shapes that remain legible when shrunk into a menu button. Refined and dramatic, with controlled detail rather than visual clutter.
Composition: wide landscape approximately 3:1, edge-to-edge artwork filling every corner. Place the most striking jagged peaks and crimson atmospheric light in the middle-right and right. Keep the left third darker, quieter and lower contrast for the separate trophy icon, but still fully painted with shadowed terrain and storm atmosphere. Retain a dark lower-middle area for a UI title. Clear depth from foreground rock silhouettes to distant illuminated spires. No blank margins.
Palette and mood: charcoal black, graphite, cold silver-grey rock edges, deep oxblood clouds and concentrated vermilion-red light. Strong ominous contrast, readable silhouettes, no white-hot washout.
Constraints: opaque image, fully filled background, no transparency. ENVIRONMENT ART ONLY. No trophy, cup, emblem, badge, crest, wings, insignia, logo, text, letters, numbers, border, frame, button chrome, UI mockup, ships, characters or weapons. Do not include any previous trophy or metallic emblem design. Deliver one standalone rectangular background image.

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full-bleed panoramic BACKGROUND ART for a championship cup selection button in VECTOR//NOVA, an original futuristic racing game.
Create one cinematic alien landscape, wide 3:1 composition (approximately 2172 by 724), edge-to-edge opaque painted scenery. This is solely the background layer.
Style: premium cinematic sci-fi environment concept art, realistic material response, atmospheric depth, elegant strong large-scale shapes that stay readable at small menu-button size. Controlled detail, no visual noise.
Composition: place the main vista and strongest colored light in the middle-right and right half. The left third remains quieter, darker and low-contrast, naturally filled with shadowed terrain and atmosphere. Keep the lower-middle area dark enough for a future UI label, but draw NO label. No blank space or flat black mask. Foreground, middle distance and horizon have clear depth.
Constraints: scenery ONLY. NO trophy, cup, badge, emblem symbol, crest, icon, medal, shield, wings, insignia, logo, lettering, text, numbers, border, frame, UI, button chrome, characters, ships, weapons or contact sheet. Do not composite any object over the scenery. No transparent areas. One standalone wide background.
Scene: FOUNDERS CUP, the first and most approachable tier. A serene, expansive alien valley with broad mossy terraces and smoothly weathered charcoal stone, calm narrow emerald water channels and a few thin distant waterfalls. Rounded ridges and an open inviting horizon, no sharp threatening peaks. A softly glowing green auroral haze above the far valley suggests a futuristic world without literal technology. Simple balanced landforms with plenty of breathing space; a feeling of possibility and ease.
Palette: charcoal foreground rock, deep forest and jade green foliage, soft pale-sage highlights inspired by #85BE99. Cool neutral sky, restrained green atmosphere on the right. Natural rich materials rather than a uniform green tint. No red, purple or hot orange accents. Soft light, composed and welcoming, while retaining the dark cinematic menu family.

Scene: FRONTIER CUP, the second, medium tier. An immense windswept alien canyon of layered ochre stone mesas and one monumental natural arch in the middle-right. Terraced cliffs, broad amber sand shelves and progressively deeper ravines recede toward a distant horizon. Windblown dust catches warm side light, suggesting adventure and a step up in challenge. Strong angular plateaus and the arch supply a distinct silhouette; more rugged and exposed than a gentle valley, but not apocalyptic or spiked.

Gold is the clear accent, not neon yellow. Controlled warm side lighting and long shadows. No green, red or purple accent lights.

Scene: HORIZON CUP, the third, hard tier. A hostile alien escarpment above a turbulent cloud sea. Huge broken tilted basalt slabs form jagged, blade-like ridges and interrupted narrow shelves over a deep abyss. A vast low crimson setting sun, partly obscured by ash clouds, silhouettes the right-hand cliff teeth. Wind-driven ash and severe oblique light imply high speed, risk and exposure. Asymmetric layered ridges rather than a single central mountain. Rugged, demanding and dramatic, yet less otherworldly and overwhelmingly spiked than the legendary final tier.
Palette: near-black basalt, graphite and cool silver-grey rock edges, concentrated garnet and crimson horizon light with pale dusty-red highlights inspired by #DE9191. Deep red sun light grazes the cliff edges; keep the rock mostly neutral. Avoid lava rivers, neon glow, purple accents and large white-hot areas. No added lightning necessary.
